csv_project_name: AE for 9500 Pescadero Creek Security & Fire Alarm
csv_scope_of_work: San Mateo County Parks is requesting proposals for the design, installation, monitoring, and maintenance of a fire and security alarm system for its main park ranger office. The selected vendor will be responsible for providing a complete solution that meets all applicable local, state, and national fire and life safety codes, as well as standard security best practices. 1. System Design and Installation Replace or upgrade existing fire alarm and burglar/intrusion systems with an integrated solution. Provide a Fire Alarm Control Panel with backup power and necessary communicators for monitoring and emergency dispatch. Install and configure the following types of devices as needed: o Smoke detectors and heat sensors o Manual pull stations o Horns, strobes, and emergency notification devices o Door and window contacts, motion detectors, and perimeter protection devices o Zone expanders, keypads, and access control hardware o Video surveillance cameras and recording equipment (if proposed) Provide proper permitting and inspections required by the County of San Mateo or other authorities having jurisdiction. Remove and properly dispose of obsolete or non-functional equipment. 2. Monitoring Services 24/7 emergency monitoring for fire and intrusion events. Verification calls and dispatch to emergency responders as needed. False alarm protection and reporting. Ability to integrate monitoring data from all system components. 3. Maintenance and Support Provide an initial warranty covering parts and labor for a minimum of one year. Offer ongoing service agreements for inspection, testing, repair, and replacement of system components, including fire alarms, sprinklers/backflow (if applicable), burglar alarm systems, and emergency notification devices. Provide documentation for all inspections, maintenance, and service activities. 4. Compliance and Safety All work must comply with current California fire codes, NFPA standards, and County regulations. Vendor must ensure that all installed equipment is compatible with existing infrastructure or provide recommendations for upgrades. Vendor must coordinate with County staff for system testing, training, and final acceptance. 5. Vendor Qualifications Demonstrated experience installing and monitoring fire and security systems in commercial or public facilities. Certified technicians for fire and security system installation and maintenance. Ability to provide references and proof of licensing and insurance as required by California law.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Inspection Services, Security Design, Vulnerability Assessments, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
